trace.why: Stick map (QRSS computer line plot, black lines without thickness, about 3-4 px on this 3.3x upscale): traced as lines, no thickness. Labels are masked by the OCR, the digits of 'French Flow 1' and '2' by hand. The two V-shaped label leaders (Gandalf, French Flow 2) stand apart from the lines and are erased by hand (the leader detector wants an end by the label; these meet at their vertex). The whole survey is one ink shape on the map; gaps kept as drawn (jumps): the Broken line ends free about 7 m short of the Orange Pekoe line. joinShortPx 40 with joinNearEnds keeps the short junction pieces.

symbols.why: QRSS computer line plot (Jim Coke): no depths (no overlined, circled or boxed number: OCR words and the whole sheet checked by eye), no letter codes, no legend, no flow arrows (French Flow 1 and 2 are line names, not arrows) and no bones. Line names kept as place names, at their labels; Gandalf and French Flow 2 at the line their V-shaped leaders point to.
